industry.note: Goods are inventory, not cash. Actual production less intermediate inputs appears as modeled value added in province GDP. No inferred 1990 factories or power stations.

investment_choices.description: Factories, machine shops, and construction suppliers.
investment_choices.effect: Enables Machinery Works and Materials Processing in this province.
investment_choices.name: Industrial Estates

investment_choices.description: Substations and transmission for new industrial facilities.
investment_choices.effect: Delivers 5 modeled power units/day per level to this province; requires national generation.
investment_choices.name: Power Grid

investment_choices.description: Tool and machine production for civilian capital projects.
investment_choices.effect: Uses intermediate packs, copper and power to produce 0.5 capital-goods packs/day per level.
investment_choices.name: Machinery Works
investment_choices.reason: No eligible province yet. Check standing, budget, technology and built prerequisites on the production board.

investment_choices.description: New dispatchable generation for modeled industrial activity only.
investment_choices.effect: Supplies up to 10 modeled power units/day per level; burns coal only when a factory runs.
investment_choices.name: Power Generation

investment_choices.description: Converts ore and fuel into usable industrial intermediates.
investment_choices.effect: Uses iron, bauxite, coal and power to produce 1 intermediate pack/day per level.
investment_choices.name: Materials Processing
investment_choices.reason: No eligible province yet. Check standing, budget, technology and built prerequisites on the production board.

investment_choices.description: An upgrade to a mapped coastal freight gateway.
investment_choices.effect: +25% modeled terminal throughput per level, shared by every shipment through this gateway.
investment_choices.name: Freight Terminal

investment_choices.description: Storage for manufactured intermediate and capital-goods packs.
investment_choices.effect: +250 storage capacity for each industrial good per level. Full storage pauses its producer; no stock is destroyed.
investment_choices.name: Industrial Warehouses

investment_choices.description: Robot cells and controls fitted to a real civilian plant.
investment_choices.effect: +20% local civilian line throughput per level, with proportionate inputs, power and cash. Requires Industrial Robot Cells.
investment_choices.name: Factory Automation
investment_choices.reason: No eligible province yet. Check standing, budget, technology and built prerequisites on the production board.

investment_choices.description: Process improvements fitted to a real civilian plant.
investment_choices.effect: Cuts new local plant power and generating-fuel use by 10% per level, capped at 50%. Requires Lean Production.
investment_choices.name: Energy Efficiency
investment_choices.reason: No eligible province yet. Check standing, budget, technology and built prerequisites on the production board.

investment_choices.effect: Creates service jobs and additional taxable value added when skilled workers, electricity and domestic demand are available. GDP and tax receipts are reported separately.
investment_choices.name: Office District

investment_choices.description: Electronics, precision components, and advanced machine production.
investment_choices.effect: Produces advanced component packs for storage and trade. Supplier component contracts are a later integration step; existing equipment orders are unchanged. Needs skilled workers, electricity, intermediate packs, copper, rare earths and operating funds.
investment_choices.name: Advanced Industry

investment_choices.description: Turn an eligible mapped deposit into national resource production.
investment_choices.effect: Feeds your physical resource stockpile. Deposit and commodity requirements still apply.
investment_choices.name: Develop a mine

native_preview.note: Services use their standing budgets. Civilian capital appropriations support the shared Construction budget and operating plants. Construction pays only for delivered work; factory inputs and equipment remain separate operating purchases. Annual dollars follow GDP. Realized investment reaches the economy on the following day.

tradeoff: Transfer 2.5 percentage points of GDP from Infrastructure to Defense, prioritising procurement while preserving absolute personnel, operations and maintenance funding. This deliberately reduces infrastructure appropriations; future authority must accrue through actual days.
